title: chg's selection fixes merge on a measured widening proof

story.i_want_to: have the delivery loop merge a fix to chg's test selection without me
story.so_that: chg improves its own selection from its own misses

rationale: Mark, 2026-11-18, on chg's fixes reaching him by design: 'I would argue that should be the first place the automatic feedback loop should be implemented.' The human step guarded against a fix that hides a miss by selecting fewer tests; a server-side measurement that selection only widened guards against the same thing.

acceptance_criteria.description: DELIVERY_GATES_CONFIG gains a mkreyman/chg entry: chg's selection code (cli/src/cover.rs, adapters/*/lib/**, and the affected-test modules the KB 4a86157b floor names for selection) is effect_paths; the rest of that floor (gate, check, adapter contract, output, verify, main, culprit, revert, CI workflows) stays human_paths. Every glob is matched against the chg repository's file list before it ships (mix loopctl.gates.check_drift).

A selection proof is the selection_replay the story's verifier recorded with its verify@1 pass verdict, on the dispatch ledger row of the story's verifier_dispatch_id, for the stage row's current head (Loopctl.Changes.SelectionProof). Not chg ledger rows: those are signed with a source secret every fleet machine holds, so an implementer could write one naming any dispatch id; the verifier's key never leaves loopctl. It passes when (a) for a story from a selection_miss finding, the replay at the finding's commit covers every test the gate failed there, as loopctl recorded them on the finding, and (b) a corpus of at least SelectionProof.min_corpus/0 commits drops no test its base selected.

MergePrecondition clears a :prove_effect Gate B outcome on the chg repository with that measured proof; a caller-supplied effect_proof still cannot clear it. A missing, partial or narrowing proof refuses with reasons naming the missing replay or each narrowed commit.
A chg change touching any human_paths file still escalates, proof or not.

test_cases.name: widening proof merges
preconditions: verifier replay rows that select the missed test and a superset everywhere

test_cases.name: narrowing refuses
preconditions: one corpus commit selects fewer tests on the head

test_cases.name: implementer rows do not count
preconditions: replay rows naming the implementer dispatch

test_cases.name: human path still escalates
preconditions: a change to cli/src/revert.rs with a passing proof

technical_notes: Runner and chg side: the verify@1 template runs chg's replay of the head against the base over a commit corpus (and the finding's miss commit) and reports it as the optional selection_replay field of its agent_result. Handed off on the loopctl-runner and chg channels.

Mark said on 2026-11-18 to let chg's own fixes merge without him, because chg should keep improving its own practices. This narrows the KB 4a86157b floor for selection code only; update that article when this ships.
